native_verification.windows_scope_note: Windows verification is scoped, not the full upstream suite.

exclusions.rationale: Upstream go-atomic nocmp_test.go sets cmd.Env to HOME only, so TEMP/TMP are unset and Go temp defaults to C:\Windows, causing access denied on Windows. Narrow Windows-only exclusion of precisely ^TestNocmpIntegration$; held-out task tests are never excluded and Linux runs the full native suite.

legacy_repos.rationale: Pinned go-difflib repo has no go.mod and contains exactly difflib/difflib.go and difflib/difflib_test.go (stdlib only). Native and held-out checks use explicit Go source-file arguments and -vet=off: its unchanged upstream tests have pre-existing nonconstant fmt.Printf and example-name vet errors on Go 1.27.1. All upstream behavioral tests and held-out assertions still run. Static vet is not part of this legacy task's acceptance, for either comparison arm; no module or upstream source is modified.

repositories.task: Add correctly validated underscore separators to ParseBytes integer inputs without weakening overflow detection.
Fix CopyOnWriteFs.RemoveAll so base-only targets return EPERM and remain intact, while overlay-only and shadowed targets retain correct RemoveAll behavior.
Add a documented ErrorsSnapshot API that returns a stable shallow copy of the accumulated error slice, including safe nil-receiver behavior.
Implement encoding.TextMarshaler and encoding.TextUnmarshaler for Bool using canonical strconv boolean text, preserving the previous value on invalid input.
Correct SplitLines empty and trailing-newline semantics: empty input has no lines, and splitting preserves existing line terminators without inventing an extra line.
Avoid delegating WithValues to the sink when no values are supplied; return the equivalent logger without cloning while preserving non-empty behavior.
